Basic chat completion via the Anthropic provider (claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022) with system and user messages

```go title="Go"
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	pkg "github.com/xberg-io/liter-llm/packages/go"
)

func ptr[T any](value T) *T { return &value }
func main() {
	request := pkg.ChatCompletionRequest{
		Model:       `anthropic/claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022`,
		Temperature: ptr(float64(0)),
		MaxTokens:   ptr(uint64(16)),
	}

	if clientErr != nil {
		panic(clientErr)

	}
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result)
```
